- Overestimate prices in the short term after sentiment spikes (e.g., +0.33 to +0.50) — reduce forecast by 1–2% for next 3–5 days.
- Underestimate prices after sentiment dips (e.g., -0.25 to 0.00) — add 1–3% to forecast for next 3–7 days.
- Overshoot after sharp price spikes (e.g., 70.93 → 71.17) — cap forecast at 10% above recent peak for 2–3 days.
- Mean-reversion bias: if forecast is >10% above 30-day moving average, reduce by 1–2% per day until convergence.
- Sentiment +0.50 or higher → model tends to overreact; apply downward bias of 0.5–1.5% for 3–5 days.
- Sentiment -0.25 or lower → model underreacts; apply upward bias of 0.5–1.5% for 3–5 days.
- Forecast horizon 30d: if last 3–5 days show strong downward trend, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% per day for next 5 days.
